dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kaka míke, kí líwa ezali mingi.
dialogue.translation: Only this, that food is too much.

key_phrases.translation: Are you going to eat this food?

key_phrases.phrase: Te, ná kí líwa kaka mpo ngai.
key_phrases.translation: No, and that food is only for me.

scenario: At the bank for a simple transaction
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of Lingala

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kɔ́mɔ sɔ́lɔ na líwa, kɔ́lɔ́.
dialogue.translation: Give me the money in hand, friend.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kíko olingi kɔ́ ná mísá mpe sɔ́lɔ?
dialogue.translation: What do you want to do with the card and money?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Móna, ná sɔ́lɔ kaka mpe kɔ́mɔ na ngai.
dialogue.translation: Look, I just want the money and give it to me.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kí ozalí kɔ́lɔ́, kɔ́mɔ sɔ́lɔ na yo líwa.
dialogue.translation: Since you are a friend, I will give you the money in your hand.

key_phrases.translation: Give the money in hand
What do you want to do
